On each listed map this is the whole set of NPCs, with cell and facing as shown (NpcSpawnContent.ReadOfficial): an empty list means the map had none.
A row with a criterion and a 'kept' note is a quest NPC the capturing character could not see there (Jondo's own quest data sends the player to it on this map); it is kept, gated by the quest.
